subject: science
concept: Creating a simple graph (bar or line) to represent investigation data
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Analyzing and Interpreting Data) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a bar graph from a completed data table using physical or virtual blocks
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a data table to the graph that correctly represents it
exercise.abstract: Student constructs a labeled graph from a given data table

misconception_flags: creates a graph with mismatched or missing axis labels

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
